scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana - Special Projects
other_conditions: Must belong to marginalized or vulnerable groups such as Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, transgender, persons with disabilities, women, economically backward people, or any other recognized marginalized/vulnerable category
Must be from difficult or remote geographies such as Left Wing Extremist areas, aspirational districts, J&K, Ladakh, North East states, or Island territories
Must have an Aadhaar ID during enrolment
Must maintain at least 70% attendance to be eligible for assessments
benefits_summary: Provides training, financial incentives, insurance, accommodation and travel support, and placement assistance for marginalized and remote candidates.
